name: Oil Price Spike
description: A major supply disruption sends oil prices surging and ripples through the broader market

phases.name: Supply Disruption
headlines: Major oil pipeline attack disrupts 3 million barrels per day of production
Strait of Hormuz tensions escalate as naval forces deployed
Oil prices surge 15% as supply disruption threatens global energy markets
phases.summary: A critical supply disruption removes significant oil production from the market, sending prices sharply higher.

phases.name: Refinery Impact
headlines: Gasoline prices hit record highs as refinery margins explode
Airlines and transport stocks hammered by surging fuel costs
Consumer inflation expectations spike on energy price shock
phases.summary: Surging oil prices cascade through the economy, crushing transportation margins and stoking inflation fears.

phases.name: Crisis Resolved
headlines: Diplomatic breakthrough eases oil supply concerns
Strategic petroleum reserve release stabilizes crude prices
Oil prices retreat sharply as supply disruption resolved faster than expected
phases.summary: Diplomatic resolution and strategic reserves stabilize the oil market, easing inflationary pressures.

phases.name: Escalation
headlines: Second major oil facility targeted as conflict widens
OPEC unable to offset supply losses as spare capacity exhausted
Oil breaches $150 as market fears prolonged shortage
phases.summary: The supply crisis escalates with additional disruptions and exhausted spare capacity pushing oil to extreme levels.

phases.name: Market Normalization
headlines: Energy markets return to pre-crisis levels as supply fully restored
Inflation fears ease as oil price shock proves transitory
phases.summary: Full supply restoration returns energy markets to normal and alleviates inflation concerns.

phases.name: Stagflation Threat
headlines: Economists warn of stagflation as energy costs crush growth
Central bank faces impossible choice between inflation and recession
Consumer spending collapses under weight of energy prices
phases.summary: Persistently high energy prices push the economy toward stagflation with growth collapsing alongside surging inflation.

name: Gold Rush
description: A flight to safety drives gold to record highs as investors flee risk assets

phases.name: Flight to Safety
headlines: Gold surges as geopolitical uncertainty drives safe haven demand
Central bank gold purchases hit record levels amid dollar concerns
Investors flock to precious metals as equity volatility spikes
phases.summary: Mounting geopolitical fears and central bank buying drive a sharp rally in gold as investors seek safety.

phases.name: Record Prices
headlines: Gold shatters all-time high as institutional allocation surges
Mining stocks explode higher as gold enters new price paradigm
Retail gold demand creates shortages at major dealers
phases.summary: Gold breaks through to record highs driven by institutional and retail demand, pulling capital from equities.

phases.name: Peak and Reversal
headlines: Gold rally fizzles as risk appetite returns on positive economic data
Profit-taking hammers gold as geopolitical tensions ease
Equity markets rally as safe haven flows reverse
phases.summary: Easing tensions and improving economic data trigger profit-taking in gold and a rotation back into equities.

phases.name: Continued Surge
headlines: Gold rally enters parabolic phase as multiple crises converge
Currency debasement fears accelerate gold hoarding worldwide
Equities face sustained headwind as gold absorbs investment flows
phases.summary: Multiple converging crises push gold into a parabolic rally, draining liquidity from equity markets.

phases.name: Risk-On Returns
headlines: Markets normalize as fear premium dissipates across asset classes
Equity inflows resume as gold retreats from highs
phases.summary: A broad normalization of risk appetite drives capital back into equities as the fear premium fades.

phases.name: New Monetary Regime
headlines: Permanent shift to hard assets reshapes investment landscape
Equity valuations compressed as real rates surge and gold dominates
Traditional portfolio models abandoned as gold allocation doubles
phases.summary: A structural shift toward hard assets permanently compresses equity valuations and reshapes the investment landscape.

name: Copper Crash
description: Collapsing Chinese demand for copper sends industrial metals and related equities sharply lower

phases.name: Demand Collapse
headlines: Chinese copper imports plunge to five-year low amid construction slowdown
Industrial metals selloff accelerates on weak Chinese manufacturing data
Copper inventories surge as demand destruction exceeds expectations
phases.summary: A sharp slowdown in Chinese construction and manufacturing triggers a collapse in copper demand.

phases.name: Mining Sector Pain
headlines: Major mining companies announce production cuts and capex freezes
Mining stocks crater as copper falls below cost of production for many
Resource-dependent economies face currency crises on commodity collapse
phases.summary: Falling copper prices force mining companies to cut production and freeze investment, crushing mining equities.

phases.name: China Stimulus
headlines: Beijing announces massive infrastructure stimulus package
Copper prices rebound sharply on China stimulus optimism
Mining stocks surge as demand outlook improves on policy support
phases.summary: A large Chinese stimulus package targeting infrastructure revives copper demand expectations and mining stocks.

phases.name: Deeper Downturn
headlines: China property crisis deepens, crushing copper demand further
Multiple mining companies suspend dividends as losses mount
Resource currencies hit multi-year lows on extended commodity rout
phases.summary: The Chinese property crisis deepens further, extending the copper crash and causing widespread mining sector distress.

phases.name: Demand Recovery
headlines: Copper demand recovers as stimulus flows through to construction sector
Green energy transition supports sustained copper demand growth
phases.summary: Stimulus-driven construction and green energy demand support a sustained recovery in copper and mining equities.

phases.name: Structural Oversupply
headlines: Copper market faces years of oversupply as new mines come online
Mining sector consolidation accelerates as smaller players fail
Industrial metals enter structural bear market, analysts warn
phases.summary: New mine supply coming online into weak demand creates a structural oversupply that depresses prices for years.

name: Agriculture Crisis
description: Severe drought conditions trigger a global agriculture crisis with soaring food prices

phases.name: Drought Emergency
headlines: Historic drought devastates major grain-producing regions worldwide
Wheat and corn futures surge as crop forecasts slashed dramatically
Food companies warn of significant input cost increases ahead
phases.summary: A historic drought across major agricultural regions triggers emergency crop forecast revisions and surging commodity prices.

phases.name: Food Inflation Spike
headlines: Global food prices hit record highs as supply shortages intensify
Consumer staples companies unable to pass through surging input costs
Social unrest spreads in emerging markets over food affordability
phases.summary: Surging food prices create a global inflation shock, squeezing consumer companies and sparking social instability.

phases.name: Rains Return
headlines: Weather patterns shift as rains return to key agricultural regions
Next season crop forecasts significantly improved, easing food fears
Agricultural commodity prices retreat sharply on improved outlook
phases.summary: Improving weather conditions and better crop forecasts ease the food crisis and reduce inflationary pressures.

phases.name: Famine Conditions
headlines: UN declares food emergency as drought enters second season
Multiple nations impose grain export bans, worsening global shortage
Food riots erupt across developing nations as prices become unaffordable
phases.summary: The drought persists into a second season, triggering export bans, food emergencies, and global market instability.

phases.name: Supply Normalizes
headlines: Bumper harvest expectations drive agricultural prices to pre-crisis levels
Food inflation eases sharply as supply chain normalizes
phases.summary: A strong harvest season normalizes agricultural supply and food prices return to manageable levels.

phases.name: Global Food Insecurity
headlines: Permanent shift in global food security calculus as stockpiles depleted
Agricultural land prices surge as food security becomes national priority
Markets face prolonged inflationary regime driven by structural food shortage
phases.summary: Depleted stockpiles and structural supply concerns create a lasting shift in food security priorities and persistent inflation.

name: Rare Earth Squeeze
description: Export restrictions on rare earth minerals create a supply crisis for technology and defense sectors

phases.name: Export Restrictions
headlines: China announces sweeping rare earth export restrictions citing national security
Technology and defense stocks tumble on rare earth supply fears
Rare earth prices double overnight as export quotas imposed
phases.summary: Sudden export restrictions on rare earth minerals create an immediate supply crisis for technology and defense manufacturers.

phases.name: Tech Scramble
headlines: Major tech firms warn of production delays due to rare earth shortage
Defense contractors face critical supply chain disruptions
Governments announce emergency stockpile releases of rare earth minerals
phases.summary: Technology and defense companies scramble for alternative supplies as rare earth shortages threaten production.

phases.name: Alternative Sources
headlines: New rare earth mining projects fast-tracked across allied nations
Recycling technology breakthrough reduces rare earth dependency
Diplomatic negotiations ease rare earth export restrictions
phases.summary: A combination of new mining projects, recycling breakthroughs, and diplomacy eases the rare earth supply crisis.

phases.name: Prolonged Shortage
headlines: Rare earth shortage worsens as restrictions expanded to additional minerals
Tech companies forced to redesign products around mineral constraints
Defense readiness concerns mount as critical components unavailable
phases.summary: Expanded restrictions and lack of alternatives deepen the rare earth crisis, forcing costly product redesigns.

phases.name: Supply Chain Diversified
headlines: Diversified rare earth supply chains reduce geopolitical risk premium
Tech sector rallies as supply security improves
phases.summary: Successful diversification of rare earth supplies reduces the geopolitical risk premium on technology stocks.

phases.name: Tech Decoupling
headlines: Global tech supply chain splits into competing blocs
Massive capex required for rare earth independence weighs on margins
Permanent supply chain restructuring costs hit tech sector earnings
phases.summary: The rare earth crisis triggers a permanent decoupling of global tech supply chains with massive restructuring costs.

name: Lithium Shortage
description: China restricts lithium exports, triggering an EV battery supply chain crisis as automakers scramble for alternatives

phases.name: Export Restrictions
headlines: China imposes strict lithium export quotas citing strategic resource protection
EV stocks plunge as lithium supply chain faces critical disruption
Battery-grade lithium prices spike 40% on export quota announcement
phases.summary: China imposes lithium export quotas, immediately threatening EV battery production and sending automaker stocks lower.

phases.name: Battery Shortage
headlines: Major EV manufacturers announce production delays due to battery cell shortage
Lithium spot prices triple as automakers compete for dwindling supply
Battery recycling firms surge as industry desperately seeks alternative sources
phases.summary: Battery cell shortages force EV production delays across the industry as lithium prices reach unprecedented levels.

phases.name: Alternative Supply
headlines: Australian and Chilean lithium mines fast-track expansion to fill supply gap
New direct lithium extraction technology promises faster production ramp
EV stocks recover as alternative supply chains begin delivering material
phases.summary: Australian and Chilean mining expansions combined with new extraction technology begin to alleviate the lithium shortage.

phases.name: EV Market Collapse
headlines: EV demand destruction accelerates as vehicle prices surge on battery costs
Multiple EV startups announce factory closures and workforce reductions
Traditional automakers halt EV investment plans amid lithium crisis
phases.summary: Sustained lithium shortage destroys EV demand as vehicle prices become unaffordable, triggering factory closures across the sector.

phases.name: Supply Diversified
headlines: Lithium market normalizes as diversified supply chains reach full capacity
EV production resumes normal pace with secure multi-source supply agreements
phases.summary: Diversified lithium supply chains reach full capacity, normalizing battery costs and restoring EV production schedules.

phases.name: Permanent Reshoring
headlines: Governments mandate domestic battery gigafactory construction at massive cost
EV sector faces years of elevated costs from reshored supply chains
Battery material independence comes at steep price as gigafactory boom strains budgets
phases.summary: A gigafactory construction boom reshores battery production but permanently elevates costs, weighing on EV sector margins.

name: Natural Gas Crisis
description: A pipeline disruption during an extreme cold snap triggers a winter energy crisis with surging gas prices

phases.name: Supply Disruption
headlines: Major natural gas pipeline shutdown removes critical winter supply capacity
Natural gas futures surge 30% as pipeline disruption meets polar vortex
Utility stocks whipsaw on fears of supply shortfall during peak heating demand
phases.summary: A major pipeline shutdown coinciding with extreme cold weather sends natural gas prices surging and threatens winter energy supply.

phases.name: Winter Emergency
headlines: Rolling blackouts hit major cities as power grid buckles under heating demand
Industrial facilities ordered to shut down to preserve residential gas supply
Energy-intensive manufacturers face catastrophic losses from forced shutdowns
phases.summary: Rolling blackouts and mandatory industrial shutdowns devastate economic activity as the energy crisis deepens.

phases.name: Mild Resolution
headlines: Weather forecast shifts to milder temperatures, easing heating demand
Emergency LNG cargoes arrive at terminals, stabilizing gas supply
Pipeline repairs ahead of schedule as gas prices retreat from highs
phases.summary: Milder weather, emergency LNG deliveries, and faster pipeline repairs combine to ease the energy crisis.

phases.name: Prolonged Shortage
headlines: Second polar vortex event extends energy crisis as storage levels collapse
Government declares energy emergency and implements gas rationing
Natural gas prices hit all-time record as rationing fails to contain demand
phases.summary: A second cold snap overwhelms remaining gas storage, forcing government rationing and pushing prices to record extremes.

phases.name: Market Recovery
headlines: Natural gas prices return to seasonal norms as winter demand fades
Industrial production resumes fully as energy supply stabilizes
phases.summary: The end of winter heating season and restored pipeline capacity normalize gas prices and industrial activity.

phases.name: Energy Policy Overhaul
headlines: Government mandates massive renewable energy buildout after gas crisis
Utility sector faces trillion-dollar infrastructure overhaul requirements
Energy transition costs weigh on industrial competitiveness for years
phases.summary: The crisis triggers a sweeping renewable energy mandate that imposes massive transition costs on utilities and industry.

name: Steel Dumping
description: Global steel overcapacity leads to cheap imports flooding markets, crushing domestic producers and sparking trade tensions

phases.name: Dumping Detected
headlines: Steel imports surge 60% as foreign producers dump below-cost product
Domestic steel prices collapse to decade lows under flood of cheap imports
Steel industry files emergency anti-dumping petition with trade commission
phases.summary: A massive surge of below-cost steel imports collapses domestic prices and threatens the viability of local producers.

phases.name: Industry Distress
headlines: Major steel mills announce temporary shutdowns and mass layoffs
Steel industry lobbies aggressively for emergency tariff protection
Rust Belt communities face economic devastation as plants go idle
phases.summary: Domestic steel producers shut plants and lay off workers as cheap imports make production uneconomic, intensifying political pressure.

phases.name: Tariff Protection
headlines: Government imposes emergency 25% tariffs on steel imports
Domestic steel stocks rally sharply on tariff protection announcement
Steel prices stabilize as import flood slows under new tariff regime
phases.summary: Emergency tariffs stem the tide of cheap imports, allowing domestic steel prices and producers to stabilize.

phases.name: Trade Retaliation
headlines: Trading partners announce retaliatory tariffs on multiple export sectors
Trade war escalation hammers industrial and agricultural stocks
Global trade volumes contract sharply as tariff barriers multiply
phases.summary: Steel tariffs trigger a broader trade war with retaliatory measures hitting multiple sectors and contracting global trade.

phases.name: Protected Recovery
headlines: Domestic steel mills reopen as tariff-protected prices support production
Industrial sector stabilizes with normalized steel supply and pricing
phases.summary: Tariff protection allows domestic mills to reopen and the industrial sector to recover with stable steel supply.

phases.name: Industrial Recession
headlines: Tariff cascades push downstream manufacturers into recession
Auto and construction sectors hammered by elevated input costs
Trade war damage spreads across industrial economy as supply chains fracture
phases.summary: Escalating tariffs hurt downstream industries dependent on affordable steel, dragging the broader industrial economy into recession.
